text:
chris: FYI Bluebridge is seeing a flurry of 429s from their Dedicated pool around 11:20 UTC yesterday. They say TPS spike exhausted their tokens within minutes.

dana: ugh. got their ticket. Can you drop the admission controller logs for pool=dedicated-eu-3? thinking noisy-tenant or preemptive admission kicking in.

evansre-bot: deploy-bot: admission-controller v2.8 rolled at 10:55 UTC (autoscale flags unchanged).

evan: grabbing logs now. early look: admission decision shows many small requests from tenant snapcart at exactly same second, token bucket drained then refill lagged. Looks like refill smoothing didn't keep up.

chris: repro plan — simulate 6k concurrent short requests @ 1-2 tokens each to that pool and watch per-tenant counters + global headroom. Use curl-loop or k6.

chris: quick snippet i used to repro locally:
```bash
# light-weight repro, produces ~6k rps for 60s
k6 run --vus 600 --duration 60s script.js 
# or simple loop
for i in $(seq 1 6000); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"prompt\":\"x\",\"max_tokens\":8}'; done
```

dana: logs: admission-controller: admit=false reason=burst_credits_exhausted tenant=snapcart pool=dedicated-eu-3 headroom=120 tokens_left=0 refill_rate=50/s

evan: interesting: snapcart's burst window was consumed but we also saw 30% of capacity used by many tenants sending chat-like 2-token requests — noisy small requests are starving the refill algorithm.

chris: sounds like fairshare not enforced correctly for small-token bursts. Could be preemptive admission allowed undoctored prewarm (we prewarm by tenant priority) causing imbalance.

dana: I toggled a mitigation: temporarily increased pool_headroom from 120->300 and enabled short-term refill_burst_smoothing=true for that pool. Please monitor.

capacity-team: marked—we're on it. We will run a controlled smoothing rollout and patch the refill algorithm to weight by token count rather than request count. ETA for PR: ~4h.

evan: tenant message to Bluebridge: we gave a temporary bump and created ticket #SUP-4579. Asked for their recent traffic ACL so we can correlate.

chris: observed immediate drop in 429s after headroom bump. Still seeing periodic micro-429 spikes when snapcart sends many concurrent small requests.

dana: short-term playbook update: (1) increase headroom, (2) enable smoothing flag, (3) throttle noisy tenant to fairshare limit, (4) collect per-tenant token histogram for 1h.

chris: notes for postmortem: consider changing admission controller to use token-weighted fairshare and add a token-per-second telemetry dashboard. Also think about auto-refill ramp when small-request density is high.

capacity-team: created bug CAP-2102: \"Admission refill smoothing: weight by tokens\" and scheduled for next canary.

chris: next steps for support — keep ticket SUP-4579 open, send Bluebridge a short status update and ETA for perf fix, and offer a temporary reserved queue if they expect another marketing blast.

dana: thanks. @capacity-team please prioritize the canary and add a regression test that simulates many small-token requests. :thumbsup:
